Reach 100% Exploration in a map sector to activate its Goddess Statue. Main story Goddess Statues increase your Blessing Level, raising Cart resource level caps and base Bed EXP production. Lost Goddess Statues also boost resource and EXP gains.

Pro-Tip: Prioritize unlocking map sectors with Goddess Statues early to maximize resource gains. Also, buy exploration items from Kingdom Shops to access blocked sectors and activate the Goddess Statues.
